title: PatchTST: Pretrained patch-transformers transfer to unseen forecasting tasks on ETTh1, Weather, Electricity
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using PatchTST, a patch-based channel-independent transformer. On ETTh1, Weather, Electricity, at horizon 336, Pretrained patch-transformers transfer to unseen forecasting tasks on ETTh1, Weather, Electricity. Zero-shot MSE of PatchTST pretrained on ETTh1 is within 16% of a supervised model on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference. Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured. Future work should address studying performance under explicit train/test distribution shift. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
